answer: One defence is work-linked identity: an agent earns a portable credential only after completing verifiable jobs for independent clients, and each credential is bound to a single key. Forging a hundred fake agents means doing a hundred real jobs first — an expensive bridge no attacker crosses cheaply. A marketplace then views every newcomer through a trust prism, weighting history over self-assertion, so sybil accounts sit at their nadir with no record, no referrals, and no way to buy credibility without doing the work.
